definitions.P0: Silent wrong science, conservation/legality/replay failure, canonical-state corruption, or false success evidence.
definitions.P1: Major boundary/fallback/incomplete-port/required-test defect that can produce a misleading or non-maintainable migration.

policy: Every P0/P1 must have an executable test, mechanical assertion, or registered STOP gate. Prose alone is invalid.

failure_modes.title: Python/Rust double state authority
failure_modes.trigger: Both languages mutate canonical state within one logical tick.

failure_modes.title: Phase-order drift
failure_modes.trigger: Port reorders event, demand, routing, flow, agents, invariants or metrics.

failure_modes.title: Vehicle mass drift
failure_modes.trigger: Floating or parallel token allocation creates/destroys vehicles.

failure_modes.title: Illegal route/turn
failure_modes.trigger: Dense-index remap, closure or ramp direction permits an illegal successor.

failure_modes.title: Stale routing cache
failure_modes.trigger: Incident/topology/cost/policy mutation does not invalidate dependent cache.

failure_modes.title: RNG stream divergence
failure_modes.trigger: Parallel execution or ported demand consumes random draws in a different order.

failure_modes.title: Incomplete checkpoint
failure_modes.trigger: Checkpoint omits RNG, cache, scheduler, residual carry or policy memory.

failure_modes.title: Static topology corruption
failure_modes.trigger: Port changes exact geometry, layers, turns, faces or area conservation.

failure_modes.title: Unit/dtype mismatch
failure_modes.trigger: Field is silently narrowed, reinterpreted, or loses its unit/bounds.

failure_modes.title: Silent backend fallback
failure_modes.trigger: Missing Rust or runtime error silently executes Python/JAX/Torch.

failure_modes.title: Thread-count nondeterminism
failure_modes.trigger: Work stealing or reduction order changes canonical output.

failure_modes.title: Unordered floating reduction
failure_modes.trigger: Rayon reduce/sum or floating atomics define canonical values.

failure_modes.title: Rust panic crosses FFI
failure_modes.trigger: Panic unwinds into Python or leaves partially mutated state.

failure_modes.title: Spatial queue left Python-only
failure_modes.trigger: Default switch occurs while spatial_queue_v1 still requires baseline Python.

failure_modes.title: Multirate cadence drift
failure_modes.trigger: Slow/periodic processes run at different ticks after migration.

failure_modes.title: ID/index aliasing
failure_modes.trigger: Stable IDs are confused with dense indices or overflow checked widths.

failure_modes.title: Nondeterministic hash iteration
failure_modes.trigger: HashMap/HashSet iteration affects route order, candidate identity or fingerprints.

failure_modes.title: f32/f64 policy drift
failure_modes.trigger: Flow or routing precision changes as an optimization without a versioned contract.
failure_modes.stop_gate: Block unless a separate field-level drift contract and oracle rebind are approved.

failure_modes.title: Transactional failure violation
failure_modes.trigger: Error in a late phase leaves early-phase state committed.

failure_modes.title: GPU split authority
failure_modes.trigger: CPU Rust and GPU both mutate canonical arrays without a single transaction.

failure_modes.title: GPU drift normalized
failure_modes.trigger: A failed field drift is hidden by changing tolerance or excluding a scale.
failure_modes.stop_gate: Record HOLD; do not edit the threshold, candidate matrix, or oracle in the same PR.

failure_modes.title: Failed shadow case omitted
failure_modes.trigger: Slow, failed, no-route or OOM cases disappear from promotion matrix.

failure_modes.title: Default cutover before PASS
failure_modes.trigger: Rust becomes default without exact RUST-PR-014 PASS receipt.

failure_modes.title: Same-context final review
failure_modes.trigger: Implementer or context-contaminated reviewer issues final PASS.

failure_modes.title: Per-kernel FFI survives
failure_modes.trigger: Default engine still calls Rust separately for flow/routing/agent stages.

failure_modes.title: NumPy list staging survives
failure_modes.trigger: Default path calls ndarray.tolist or builds Python numeric lists.

failure_modes.title: Mutable snapshot alias
failure_modes.trigger: Python receives writable memory that aliases canonical Rust state.

failure_modes.title: Rust CI is optional
failure_modes.trigger: Required CI skips Rust build/parity and still reports green.

failure_modes.title: Global Rayon pool dependence
failure_modes.trigger: Thread count and scheduling depend on process-global initialization.

failure_modes.title: Thread oversubscription
failure_modes.trigger: Rayon, BLAS, JAX or Torch worker pools nest without a budget.

failure_modes.title: Nightly SIMD dependency
failure_modes.trigger: Default build relies on unstable std::simd or target-native-only binary.

failure_modes.title: Microbenchmark overfit
failure_modes.trigger: A kernel benchmark improves while full-engine wall/RSS regresses.

failure_modes.title: Eager GPU dependency
failure_modes.trigger: Importing core frontend requires JAX/Torch/CUDA.

failure_modes.title: Per-tick GPU synchronization
failure_modes.trigger: Device kernel returns to host every tick, erasing gains.

failure_modes.title: Nested-vector FFI schema
failure_modes.trigger: Routes or state use Vec<Vec<T>>/Python nested lists instead of offsets.

failure_modes.title: Python tick loop remains default
failure_modes.trigger: Python still iterates links, routes, turns or agents after cutover.

failure_modes.title: Performance receipt omits costs
failure_modes.trigger: Claim excludes extension build, warmup, copies, compile, memory or Python wall.

failure_modes.title: Python oracle edited to fit Rust
failure_modes.trigger: Oracle outputs, tests or tolerances are changed in migration PRs.

failure_modes.title: Public artifact schema drift
failure_modes.trigger: Snapshots/telemetry/summaries change without version migration.

failure_modes.title: Memory growth
failure_modes.trigger: Persistent buffers, snapshots or FFI objects leak across chunks.

failure_modes.title: Neural authority creep
failure_modes.trigger: Python/JAX/Torch model mutates state or selects illegal path directly.

failure_modes.title: Per-tick Python callback
failure_modes.trigger: Rust scheduler calls Python for demand/events every tick.

failure_modes.title: Partial agent port marked complete
failure_modes.trigger: Rust plans actions but Python applies pool/queue mutations.

failure_modes.title: Workspace facade shadows Python package
failure_modes.trigger: Maturin/PyO3 install replaces or hides the root metroflow package.

failure_modes.title: Stale evidence accepted
failure_modes.trigger: Review or final decision cites a different base/final SHA or old logs.

failure_modes.title: Tie-break drift
failure_modes.trigger: Equal-cost routes differ due to float comparison or parallel order.

failure_modes.title: Residual carry omitted
failure_modes.trigger: Discrete fractional residual/carry state is reset or omitted.

failure_modes.title: Invariant checks moved only to Python
failure_modes.trigger: Rust mutates state and Python detects errors after commitment.

failure_modes.title: Small-case-only parity
failure_modes.trigger: Tests pass only on tiny graphs and omit 25/40/100/250 km2 or high-demand cases.

failure_modes.title: Fragmented backend configuration remains authority
failure_modes.trigger: Separate edge/flow/routing/agent selectors can create unsupported mixed ownership.
